We are looking for a proactive and people\-focused HR Intern who can manage end\-to\-end HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement, HR documentation, payroll coordination, and compliance support. The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, an ownership mindset, and experience working in an IT/tech environment.
   

  

**Selected Intern's Day\-to\-day Responsibilites Include**

* Source candidates via job portals, LinkedIn, consultancies, and referrals.
* Screen resumes, conduct HR rounds, and schedule technical interviews.
* Manage candidate follow\-ups, offer rollouts, and joining closures.
* Maintain a recruitment tracker and share weekly hiring status reports.
* Onboarding \& Employee Lifecycle:

* Conduct induction sessions and ensure a smooth onboarding experience.

* Payroll \& Compliance Support:
* Provide monthly payroll inputs (attendance, leave, LOP, new joiners, etc.).
* Support PF/ESI documentation and statutory compliance processes.
* Assist in audits and HR compliance documentation as required.
* Employee Engagement \& Relations:
* Coordinate engagement initiatives (birthdays, anniversaries, celebrations).
* Address employee concerns and grievances, ensuring timely resolution.
* Support management in retention activities and culture building.
* Performance Management Support:
* Assist in performance appraisal cycles and documentation.
* Coordinate review meetings and follow\-up action points.
* Support training needs identification and employee development initiatives.

The Senior Manager Training is accountable in driving overall Training Performance across all assigned accounts. Sr. Manager Training partners with Operations to provide necessary training intervention on performance gaps while coming up both short\-term to long\-term delivery plans to ensure strategies and tactics are executed against timelines, resources, process guidelines, competency requirements and expectations of Results and our partners.

* Facilitate transformational learning solutions by applying world class learning principles and instructional design methodologies that drive success and effectiveness of training in all levels of evaluation: increased learning retention, improved learning experience, increase throughput, elevated performance, and improved overall speed to proficiency

* Two or more years of successful management of training team (training delivery, instructional design, strategy)

* Superior consulting skills, (e.g., critical thinking, problem solving, decision making, and influencing)
* Strong organization skills and ability to multi\-task in a dynamic, fast paced environment
* Ability to creatively use resources and adjust to changes quickly and professionally
* Ability to analyze data for trends and able to recognize opportunities for improvement both short\-term and long\-term
* Experience developing people and running teams
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, but also in a team environment
* Superb attention to details specially in the area of Project management of big to medium initiatives and projects
* Ability to provide on\-call support

* Schedule flexibility (travel required both local and international)


Preferred Education and Experience


* Experience at ResultsCX
* Are of expertise on client\-specific training and requirements
* Knowledge of common analytics practices is a plus (Six Sigma)

ResultsCX is a premier customer experience partner to Fortune 100 and 500 companies. ResultsCX’s 30\+\-year track record for reimagining the customer experience to meet consumers’ evolving expectations has driven growth to more than 20 geographic hubs and approximately 20,000 colleagues worldwide. * **End\-to\-end Contract Lifecycle Management:** Draft, review, and negotiate contracts related to sponsorships, licensing, talent endorsement agreements, youth sports programs, and other commercial arrangements.
* **Intellectual Property:** Advise on IP management and protection, including copyrights, trademarks, branding, and personality/publicity rights to safeguard the company’s assets.
* **Compliance:** Ensure adherence to relevant laws and regulations, including those governing intellectual property, sports commercial rights, content/digital platforms, information technology, and policies/regulations prescribed by relevant sports bodies.
* **Risk Management:** Identify potential legal risks and develop strategies to mitigate them.
* **Legal Research:** Conduct research on emerging legal and commercial trends in the sports and entertainment sectors and provide actionable insights to senior management.

* Strong domain knowledge of sports, entertainment, intellectual property, and contract law
* Excellent command of legal language and drafting
* High comfort level reading and analysing large, voluminous documents
* Proven ability to manage a high volume of contracts and multiple matters simultaneously

* Hands\-on experience with media rights agreements, sponsorship deals, and talent/athlete endorsement agreements in the sports industry

* Strong practical experience in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial contracts, particularly sponsorship agreements, licensing and merchandising agreements, and talent/athlete endorsement agreements

Job Description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Role Purpose**

The purpose of the role is to ensure excellent customer service delivery of all technology solutions and products to clients, through effective project management, service metrics tracking, budget management, issue resolution, optimal resource allocation, and maintenance of a skilled team of all delivery resources for the client.


**͏**
-----

**Do**

* **Oversee and manage service delivery by meeting all contractual/ SLA commitments**
	+ Contract compliance \& adherence
		- Ensure all SLA parameters are met in the account
		- Review and drive appropriate actions/ systemic changes on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non\-compliances are cited
		- Monitor and review all projects in the account on various delivery parameters to ensure quality delivery as per budget and timelines
		- Ensure that the service credits, performance incentives, penalty and penalty waivers are incorporated in the invoices
	+ Delivery governance across the accounts/projects
		- Lead delivery teams to understand customer goals and key performance metrics and their thresholds for each project
		- Ensure that the project performance parameters stay green for all accounts
		- Monitor and review delivery dashboards/ MIS across accounts to track progress, forecast performance and identify potential red flags
		- Participate and share account performance across operational, quality and fulfillment parameters with internal/external stakeholders \& senior leadership
		- Ensure regular invoicing as per the contract terms and condition and performance
	+ Technical and/or Operational Issue Resolution
		- Manage and resolve complex project escalations, potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to eliminate any revenue leakage
		- Acts as an advisor to service delivery managers to meet schedules or resolve technical or operational problems on a daily basis
		- Acts as point of escalation for issues not resolvable by the service lines.
		- Escalate issues with financial implication on the account to Account Head and other senior stakeholders
		- Acts as an advisor to service line managers to meet schedules or resolve technical or operational problems
**͏**
-----

* Resource Allocation \& Retention
	+ Ensure effective transition from the client with the well documented and clear process understanding along with the right manpower requirements with requisite skill and training to undertake delivery
	+ Review and monitor resource planning and fulfillment in line with account requirements and costs of delivery
	+ Responsible for establishing, leading and maintaining a skilled team of all delivery resources for an account on a daily basis
	+ Plan training batches to backfill client deliveries during crucial periods
	+ Ensure retention by offering relevant trainings and certifications of all allocated resources
* Ensure Process Excellence
	+ Partner with the assigned black belt for the account on regular basis to get feedback on account performance
	+ Prioritize and drive initiatives for continuous improvement to improve top line revenue and bottom line margins
	+ Present the business case for such initiatives to the clients to get their buy\-in if required
	+ Drive and implement structured cadence around quality, both process and transactional.
	+ Conduct periodic meetings with clients and delivery teams Ã¢ÂÂ daily status updates, service level requirement reviews, continuous improvement, change control and other informal meetings to share focus points, progress and successes.
**͏**
-----

* **Contribute to revenue and profitable growth by ensuring the agreed revenue targets are met and by identifying opportunities in the form of new and/or adjacent work in the assigned account**
	+ Ensure excellent service delivery of all products and solutions to achieve approved margin targets on assigned accounts and is targeted to improve account profitability.
	+ Regularly monitors and reports on financial health of the account and remedies any financial misses or anomalies
	+ Contribute to the revenue growth of the account by supporting the Account Head through new opportunity identification for deployment of new technology, growth solutions and services within the existing account/client
	+ Recognizes business needs and determines if our portfolio offering may be an appropriate solution
	+ Qualify and prioritize new opportunities in the funnel in the form of adjacent work in existing accounts
	+ Serve as the primary relationship owner for an assigned group of top tier client accounts with responsibility for retention and growth
	+ Prepare implementation plans and ensure efficient client on\-boarding; present content strategy and annual delivery plan
	+ Partner with the process excellence team to incorporate and drive key Wipro initiatives and priorities in the account strategy such as Digital, Automation etc.
	+ Set direction for the team, track progress against targets through regular cadence calls and course correct as required
	+ Partner with the WFM, Hiring \& HR team to ensure optimal resource allocation and maintenance of a ready skilled team of resources to avoid leakages and revenue loss
**͏**
-----

* **Develop, manage and leverage relationships in account to build customer centricity**
	+ Identify key stakeholders/ decision makers in client organization and develop and strengthen relationships with them
	+ Interact and engage with the client leadership to communicate and update progress against account plan, project delivery etc.
	+ Drive and attend Steering Committee meetings or Client Review meetings to regularly review project dashboards, discuss and resolve escalation points and course correct as required for high customer satisfaction and better quality of experience
	+ Act as client advocate and work with internal departments to ensure that client needs are understood and satisfied
	+ Liaise between the customer and internal teams
* **Drive Delivery Transformation through automation and innovation focus**
	+ Create and drive automation charter and related initiatives within account client (wherever applicable)
	+ Drive deployment of automation led solutions and service improvements to deliver value added services to the clients
	+ Build focus on and drive deployment of next generation hyper automation initiatives in coordination with Holmes team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery
	+ Lead, develop and drive new ways of working (EOT, Digital, Agile etc.) and its capabilities within the account to improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters
Mandatory Skills: DCTS Wintel Consulting .  

Experience: 8\-10 Years .  

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

description:

This role needs someone who can run a high\-performing TA team while still staying close to the business by owning a slate of senior and critical mandates. You’ll steer stakeholder alignment, enforce process discipline, raise the bar on candidate quality, and shape how the function shows up across markets.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
* **We deliver the world’s most complex projects.**
* **Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team.**
* **Enjoy a varied \& challenging role.**

  

**Building on our past. Ready for the future**

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.


Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.


We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data\-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.  



  

**The Role**

***As Talent Acquisition Specialist with Worley*** , you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.


The Global Talent Acquisition Operations Partner will play a critical role in supporting and optimizing the operational facets of our Talent Acquisition (TA) function. This role will work closely with Regional TA Directors, TA Delivery teams, and global stakeholders to support and deliver key initiatives. This includes overseeing technology platforms, processes, training programs, vendor relationships, risk and compliance, privacy, and data integrity. The individual in this role will ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement of recruitment technologies and processes, while driving operational efficiency and ensuring global consistency and compliance.


* **Talent Acquisition Technology \& Systems Management:**
	+ Partner with key stakeholders to identify, optimize, and streamline the use of talent acquisition technology platforms (ATS, CRM, AI tools, job boards, staffing agencies, background check vendors, etc.) to gather insights and drive global and regional improvements in our TA tech stack and recruitment processes.
* **Process Management \& Continuous Improvement** :
	+ Partner with key stakeholders to develop, document, and refine regional talent acquisition processes ensuring consistency, efficiency, and alignment with global recruitment standards and practices.
	+ Develop continuous improvement recommendations using data insights, stakeholder feedback, and market best practices, to inform work and prioritization of improvement initiatives, applying modern and lean design principles.
	+ Partner with key stakeholders to lead and support initiatives focused on continuous process improvements aimed at enhancing overall end\-user experience, with a concentrated focus on candidate experience, hiring manager satisfaction, and recruiter productivity.
* **Project Management: Implementations \& Enhancements:**
	+ Support global projects and initiatives projects, in alignment with the Regional TA Director and Regional TA Delivery team to support the design, implementation, and optimization of new systems, tools, and processes that increase efficiency within the talent acquisition function.
	  
	
	Manage and deliver system upgrades, enhancements, and integrations to minimize disruptions and ensure high adoption rates, while measuring.
* **Vendor \& Supplier Management:**
	+ Support vendor relationships with external recruitment vendors, staffing agencies, job boards, and other third\-party suppliers, with input from Regional TA Delivery to inform desired outcomes and organizational priorities.
	+ Investigate and resolve TA vendor\-related inquiries and disputes.
* **Privacy, Compliance, \& Risk Management:**
	+ Support initiatives to assess, measure, manage, and mitigate risks associated with hiring processes, technologies, and vendor partnerships.
	  
	
	Partner with key stakeholders to lead and support process and performance audits to ensure data accuracy, efficiency, adoption, and utilization of TA processes and technology.
* **Training \& Development:**
	+ Provide ongoing training related to technology, compliance, and recruitment best practices.
* **Issue Resolution \& Support:**
	+ Serve as the primary point of contact for resolving any issues related to talent acquisition operations, such as system errors, vendor disputes, and/or process inefficiencies.
	+ Work cross\-functionally with the Regional TA Delivery teams to address operational challenges and provide timely, effective solutions to TA Operations, Digital, and Process Teams.

**About You**

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:


* A minimum of 3 years’ experience successfully leading process assessments, audits, and continuous improvement efforts in Talent Acquisition.
* A minimum of 2 years; experience supporting or leading the design and implementation of AI systems and tools, driving process optimization and adoption.
* Strong knowledge of global compliance regulations, data privacy laws, and risk management practices within the recruitment space.
* Experience managing vendor relationships, contract negotiations, and/or third\-party service agreements.
* Project management skills with the ability to oversee multiple initiatives and drive them to successful completion.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
* Advanced data analysis and interpretation skills to derive insights from data and convert them into recommendations for improvement.
* Proven track record of leading and implementing process improvements, technology upgrades, and training initiatives.
* Experience designing and/or implementing Eightfold.
* Experience with ATS system design and management.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Prior experience in recruitment.

**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.


We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.


And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.


Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.


Worley takes personal data protection seriously and respects EU and local data protection laws. You can read our full Recruitment Privacy Notice Here .


Please note: If you are being represented by a recruitment agency you will not be considered, to be considered you will need to apply directly to Worley.

description:
**Company Overview**

Cyberchrome Private Limited is a fast\-growing IT and business development company focused on building structured, scalable systems for startups and premium clients. We specialize in business development solutions, digital infrastructure, and strategic growth support.

We are transitioning from a local service model to a **premium client\-focused organization**, and we are looking for a strong HR leader to build and manage a professional workforce system.

**Skills**

* Strong leadership and decision\-making ability
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Deep understanding of organizational structure and HR systems
* Ability to handle pressure and enforce discipline
* Strategic thinking \+ execution capability

**Role Objective**

The HR Head will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing the entire HR system of Cyberchrome. This role is focused on building a **structured, disciplined, and performance\-driven team culture** aligned with business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. HR System Development

* Design and implement complete HR policies and SOPs
* Build a structured organizational hierarchy (Team Leaders, Departments, Reporting flow)
* Develop employee lifecycle systems (Hiring → Onboarding → Performance → Exit)
* Ensure the company operates in a **system\-driven structure, not person\-dependent**

2\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Plan and execute hiring strategies for all departments
* Create job descriptions and hiring pipelines
* Conduct interviews and shortlist high\-quality candidates
* Focus on hiring **growth\-oriented and disciplined professionals**

3\. Performance Management System

* Implement KPI\-based performance tracking
* Monitor employee productivity and efficiency
* Coordinate with team leaders for performance reviews
* Develop reward, incentive, and penalty systems

4\. Employee Discipline \& Culture

* Maintain strict professional communication systems
* Ensure no direct dependency between employees and top management (structured communication only through team leaders)
* Build a **high\-performance, no\-nonsense work culture**
* Handle employee conflicts and disciplinary actions

5\. Training \& Development

* Identify skill gaps and organize training programs
* Develop onboarding training systems for new employees
* Improve team productivity through continuous learning

6\. Payroll \& Compliance

* Manage salary structures, attendance, and leave systems
* Ensure compliance with labor laws and company policies
* Coordinate with accounts for payroll processing

7\. HR Analytics \& Reporting

* Track hiring metrics, employee performance, and retention rates
* Provide regular reports to management
* Suggest improvements based on data

title: Business Consulting - Product Owner - Data Platform (Incentive Compensation / Varicent Program)
description:
**Req ID:** 363102
  

  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.  

  

We are currently seeking a Business Consulting \- Product Owner \- Data Platform (Incentive Compensation / Varicent Program) to join our team in Chennai, Tamil Nādu (IN\-TN), India (IN).  

  

**Job Description:**  

  

**Role Overview**  

  

We are seeking an experienced **Product Owner \- Data Platform** with strong domain expertise in **Incentive Compensation Planning (ICP)** to drive product strategy, roadmap execution, and value realization for the enterprise Data Platform supporting the Varicent program.  

  

This role will ensure the data platform reliably powers complex compensation processes including:  

* Sales crediting and adjustments
* Hierarchy management
* Quota and territory alignment
* Incentive plan modeling
* Earnings and payout calculations
* Retro adjustments and clawbacks
* Audit, traceability, and compliance

  

The ideal candidate combines **deep ICP business understanding** with experience in **modern cloud\-based data platforms, Medallion architecture, Data Vault modeling, and governed data exposure strategies**.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

  

**1\. Product Vision \& ICP\-Aligned Strategy**  

* Define and own the **Data Platform product vision** aligned to enterprise Incentive Compensation strategy.
* Ensure the platform supports:
* + Accurate and timely compensation calculations
	+ Full auditability and lineage for payout traceability
	+ Scenario modeling and simulation needs
	+ Secure handling of sensitive compensation data
* Build and maintain a multi\-quarter roadmap covering:
* + ICP data ingestion and transformation pipelines
	+ Medallion architecture maturity (Bronze/Silver/Gold layers)
	+ Data Vault implementation for compensation entities
	+ Secure and scalable data exposure for Varicent and downstream systems
* Prioritize initiatives based on business impact (e.g., payout accuracy, cycle time reduction, dispute reduction).

  

**2\. ICP Data Domain Ownership**  

  

Act as the product authority for compensation\-related data domains, including:  

* Sales transactions \& bookings
* Crediting rules \& split logic
* Sales hierarchies and territory structures
* Quotas \& targets
* Incentive plan definitions
* Earnings \& payout calculations
* Adjustments, clawbacks, and disputes
* Historical compensation audit data

  

Ensure data models and transformations support:  

* Retroactive recalculations
* Period\-based compensation cycles
* Versioned plan structures
* Hierarchy changes over time
* Regulatory and financial compliance requirements

  

Collaborate closely with Data Architects to ensure Data Vault modeling properly represents ICP business keys (e.g., employee, plan, position, territory, transaction).  

  

**3\. Backlog Ownership \& Delivery Execution**  

* Own and manage the **Data Platform backlog** across:
* + Compensation data ingestion pipelines (batch \& streaming)
	+ Data validation and reconciliation frameworks
	+ Data quality rules specific to ICP logic
	+ Lakehouse architecture enablement (Databricks/Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift)
	+ Secure data access models (RBAC for sensitive compensation data)
* Write clear epics and user stories translating ICP requirements into technical deliverables.
* Ensure each feature supports:
* + Traceability
	+ Reproducibility of payouts
	+ SLA adherence for compensation cycles
* Balance technical enablers (e.g., metadata, lineage, observability) with business\-driven features.

  

**4\. Data Exposure \& Consumption Strategy (Compensation\-Focused)**  

* Define product strategy for governed data exposure to:
* + Varicent
	+ BI \& reporting tools
	+ Finance systems
	+ Audit \& compliance teams
* Ensure compensation data is:
* + Securely shared
	+ Masked/tokenized where required
	+ Accessible through controlled semantic layers
* Enable analytics use cases such as:
* + Earnings forecasting
	+ Incentive plan performance analysis
	+ Sales performance insights
	+ Compensation cost modeling
* Define and track SLAs for compensation data availability during payout cycles.

  

**5\. Governance, Audit \& Compliance Alignment**  

  

Given the sensitive nature of compensation data:  

* Embed governance and audit principles into platform prioritization.
* Ensure support for:
* + Data lineage from source transaction to final payout
	+ Historical snapshotting and versioning
	+ Dispute investigation workflows
	+ Role\-based data access (field rep vs manager vs finance vs HR)
* Partner with InfoSec and compliance teams to enforce:
* + Encryption (at rest \& in transit)
	+ Zero\-trust access principles
	+ Data masking and tokenization
	+ Regulatory compliance requirements

  

**6\. Metrics \& Value Realization**  

  

Define and track KPIs such as:  

* Payout accuracy rate
* Compensation dispute volume
* Cycle time for compensation processing
* Data quality scores for ICP entities
* Platform uptime during compensation runs
* Adoption of standardized data models

  

Drive continuous improvements in compensation transparency and trust.  

  

**Required Skills \& Expertise**  

  

**Incentive Compensation Domain (Mandatory)**  

* Strong experience in **Incentive Compensation Planning (ICP)**.
* Deep understanding of:
* + Sales crediting logic
	+ Hierarchies and territory management
	+ Quota management
	+ Plan design structures
	+ Earnings calculations and payout processing
	+ Retro adjustments and audit requirements
* Experience working with compensation platforms such as **Varicent** (strongly preferred).
* Understanding of financial controls and audit needs related to compensation.

  

**Product \& Delivery Expertise**  

* 8\+ years of experience in Product Ownership / Product Management.
* Proven ownership of enterprise data or platform products.
* Strong Agile backlog management and roadmap planning expertise.
* Experience operating in cross\-functional enterprise environments.

  

**Data Platform \& Technical Understanding**  

  

Strong conceptual understanding of:  

* Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
* Data Vault 2\.0 (Hubs, Links, Satellites)
* Lakehouse platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, etc.)
* Batch and streaming architectures

description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------


As a Customer Support Manager at Rippling, you will lead a high\-performing team responsible for delivering exceptional support to our customers. You will act as the point of contact (POC) for all actions and domains within your team, ensuring efficient operations, seamless collaboration, and outstanding customer experiences. This role demands a proactive, strategic mindset combined with hands\-on leadership skills to drive team performance and process improvements in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.


You will report directly to the Senior Manager, Customer Support and play a pivotal role in aligning team goals with Rippling's broader objectives while focusing heavily on talent enablement and team development.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Lead, mentor, and support team leads in their respective roles, fostering a culture of accountability and excellence.

* Handle team scheduling, attendance management, and adherence to ensure optimal staffing coverage.
* Drive the onboarding and development of early\-career employees, including campus hires and freshers.

* Monitor and analyze KPIs such as CSAT, Adherence, and ticket turnaround time.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Tech, Product, and Operations, to address and resolve recurring or complex customer issues.
* Identify patterns in customer feedback and operational inefficiencies, providing actionable insights for process optimization.
* Train and mentor team members to enhance domain knowledge, improve problem\-solving capabilities, and deliver exceptional customer support.
* Analyze team performance data and trends to identify areas for improvement and implement solutions.
* Drive automation and system improvements to reduce manual interventions and improve accuracy.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Experience: 6–9 years of experience in customer support or customer\-facing teams .
* Leadership Skills: Minimum 3–5 years of mandatory people management experience, with a proven ability to develop teams through coaching and performance management.
* Functional Must\-Haves: Hands\-on exposure to training or enablement programs and experience managing the development of early\-career cohorts (campus hires/freshers).
* Persona: High ownership, initiative, and a people\-oriented approach.
* Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with customer support platforms and HR or IT systems (preferred).
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills—clear, concise, and empathetic.
* Adaptability: Must\-have prior Night Shift experience \& Flexibility to work in US time zones and handle evolving priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Customer\-First Mindset: A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences

 **NOTE**


Comfortable working in a hybrid office environment (3 days minimum) plus working US\-business hours (EST/PST time zones).

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. **About Us:** Zivaya is a chain of luxury wellness outlets major chains of hotels, palaces, airports and lounges across India. We offer premium therapies, beauty, spa \& hair treatments.

As an Outlet Manager, you will be responsible for the QUALITY \& REVENUE of the outlet. From describing our services to the consumer to ensuring that the place and staff looks tidy,collecting payments from the guests, and upselling services, you are required to take complete ownership of the outlet.

**Timings**\-while the outlet will run for 24 hours, and you will handle the main shift, as a manager, you will still be required to monitor the operations online at random times, and collect reports to ensure quality of our services. Ability to handle conflicts within the team, and being able to constantly motivate them for high performance will be a key to success in this industry.

**Expectations**\-a highly disciplined individual with strong communication skills and a go\-getter attitude, ability to handle a team of 8\-10 people, strong work ethics and someone who can manage relationships across multiple departments. Our aspirational vision for students integrates academic excellence with life skills (including socio\- emotional development), that will enable each child to live an empowered life. We believe an empowered citizen must possess a sense of mastery to pursue excellence, a sense of agency to make informed choices and a sense of purpose to serve their communities. Over the last 30 years, Akanksha has been at the forefront of proving what’s possible for children from low\-income communities in Mumbai \& Pune. Our 5,100 alumni are on the path to living an empowered life. Today Akanksha runs 26 schools in partnership with governments of Mumbai, Pune, Pimpri\-Chinchwad, Navi Mumbai and Nagpur serving \~14,000 children in grades Jr Kg \- Gr 10\.

As an Akanksha teacher, you will be directly responsible for at least 40 kids in a class. Your role will be to guide the students toward academic achievement while inculcating self\-esteem and values in their curriculum that will empower them to think critically and make informed choices in their lives. You will cultivate an environment of high achievement coupled with fun learning in the classrooms. You will build strong bonds with children to understand each child’s needs and work with parents as partners in their child’s education and future. You will work with grades 3\-10 to implement our digital skills and computer science curriculum.

The Akanksha Schools aim to be high\-quality schools serving children from low\-income communities in Mumbai . These schools work in partnership with local municipalities, with the vision of creating small clusters of model schools in these cities that can be used to impact the mainstream education system. The School Team comprises teachers, social workers, school administrator and helpers led by the School Leader.

● Candidates with prior education/certification/experience in computer science / IT can apply

description:
Citi Analytics \& Information Management (AIM) team is a global community that objectively connects and analyzes information, to create actionable intelligence for our business leaders. The Anti Money Laundering (AML) Data Science \& Model Management (DSMM) analyst will be a part of AIM, based in Bangalore and reporting into the VP leading the team.
   

  

 The scope of work includes all aspects of analysis performed by the team within different projects: Threshold Tuning, Segmentation and data modeling/validation efforts depending on current needs and project plans. A primary area of focus for this position will be working on threshold tuning for Optimization, developing Logistic Regression Model to predict customer behavior, identifying anomalies in transaction and Customer behavior, Outlier detection, ATL threshold tuning, Segment customers into homogenous groups using clustering, Logistic Regression Model Performance Review while maintaining flexibility to switch amongst work streams based on business needs.
   

  

 The DSMM statistician will follow the globally consistent methodology but is expected to have a high level of initiative and creativity and suggest enhancements to the current methodologies. The role requires working closely with business partners based in other geographies that Citi operates in (e.g., NAM, APAC, and LATAM).
   

  

 Requirements include a background in analysis using databases, warehouses, data processing, experience with statistics and data mining. Experience and knowledge in banking and finance, especially in the AML area will be a plus. In addition, the ability to read and create formal documentation is highly desirable.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* A primary area of focus for this position will be working on threshold tuning for Optimization, developing Logistic Regression Model to predict customer behavior, identifying anomalies in transaction and Customer behavior, Outlier detection, ATL threshold tuning, Segment customers into homogenous groups using clustering, Logistic Regression Model Performance Review etc. while maintaining the flexibility to switch amongst work streams based on business needs. Apply quantitative and qualitative data analysis methods; prepare statistical and non\-statistical data exploration and advanced statistical analysis to support the threshold tuning or segmentation work streams.
* Validate data, identify data quality issues (if any), and work with Technology to address them. Analyze and interpret data reports, draw conclusions and make recommendations answering specific business needs.
* Automate data extraction and data preprocessing tasks. Perform adhoc data analysis. Design and maintain complex data manipulation processes. Provide consistent documentation and presentations.
* Develop new transaction monitoring scenarios based on emerging Financial Crime Risk
* Document solutions and present results in a simple comprehensive way to non\-technical audience, as well as write more formal documentation using statistical vocabulary.
* Generate new ideas, concepts and models to improve methods of obtaining and evaluating quantitative and qualitative data. Identify relationships and trends in data, as well as any factors that could affect the results of research. Question and validate assumptions. Escalate identified risks and sensitive areas in terms of methodology and processes.


**Qualifications:**
* 2\-4 years of experience in Financial Services / Analytics Industry
* Masters in a numerate subject such as Mathematics, Operational Research, Business Administration, Economics etc. from Premier Institute or a track record of performance that demonstrates this ability.

* Good Knowledge in Python, SQL, Hive

* Strong statistics and data analytics academic background and knowledge of quantitative methods
* Highly skilled and good knowledge of MS Excel. VBA experience is a plus
* Experience in reporting the results of analysis in clear written form, and in presenting the findings during meetings and conference calls
* Team working experience (demonstrated team player ability required)

* Ability to work well with a variety of people and to show team\-player attitude regardless of the scope of responsibilities.

description:
Viacom India is seeking an experienced **Full Stack WordPress Developer/Designer** with 1\-2\+ years of professional experience. The ideal candidate will be proficient in both front\-end and back\-end WordPress development, including the creation, customization, and optimization of themes and plugins. This role requires a strong focus on performance optimization, responsiveness, and seamless user experience, along with technical troubleshooting and ensuring compliance with web standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **WordPress Development \& Customization:**
* Develop, customize, and maintain WordPress themes and plugins according to client specifications.

* Optimize websites for speed, scalability, and responsiveness.
* Ensure mobile\-friendly and responsive design across all devices.
* Troubleshoot bugs, performance issues, and technical challenges.
* Maintain website security, compliance with web standards, and ensure functionality.
* Implement SEO best practices and ensure cross\-browser compatibility.
* Integrate APIs, third\-party services, and databases.
* Work with sitemaps and Google Analytics for tracking and analysis.
* **Front\-End Development:**
* Implement user interfaces based on design specifications using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, React, or Vue.js.
* Ensure cross\-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness.
* Optimize front\-end performance for fast loading and smooth user interaction.
* **Back\-End Development:**
* Manage WordPress backend, including database integration (MySQL) and server\-side scripting (PHP).
* Customize the WordPress admin panel and dashboard for ease of content management.
* Integrate third\-party APIs (e.g., payment gateways, social media APIs).
* Manage website security, backups, and server\-related troubleshooting.
* **Performance Optimization:**
* Use performance optimization techniques such as image compression, caching, and minimizing server load.
* Conduct site audits to resolve performance bottlenecks.
* Utilize tools like Google PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, and GTmetrix to improve speed and SEO.
* **Security Management:**
* Implement secure coding practices and regularly update software.
* Install and monitor security plugins to detect vulnerabilities.
* Manage secure authentication, user roles, and permissions.
* **Debugging \& Troubleshooting:**
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve website issues (e.g., bugs, crashes, UX problems).
* Perform regular testing to ensure cross\-device and browser compatibility.
* **SEO \& Analytics:**
* Implement SEO best practices in code structure to enhance visibility.
* Use Google Analytics and other tools to track website performance.
* Apply schema markup, metadata, and other SEO enhancements.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 1\-2\+ years of proven experience in WordPress development (front\-end \& back\-end).
* Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, PHP, and MySQL.
* Experience with theme and plugin development/customization.
* Familiarity with responsive design principles.
* Experience with WordPress page builders (e.g., Elementor, WPBakery) and frameworks.
* Knowledge of version control systems (e.g., Git).
* Proficiency in website optimization techniques (e.g., caching, CDNs, minification).
* Strong understanding of SEO best practices.
* Experience with hosting environments, FTP, cPanel, and command\-line tools.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.

**Preferred Skills (Optional):**

* Experience with Media Industery or other eCommerce platforms.
* Familiarity with RESTful APIs and third\-party integrations.
* Knowledge of web hosting environments and basic server management.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work on diverse and challenging projects.
* Be part of a collaborative and dynamic work environment.
* Competitive salary with growth opportunities.

**Candidate Assignment:**  
As part of the application process, candidates must complete the following assignment:

* **Task: Replicate the Home Page of www.viacomindia.com**
* Recreate the homepage within WordPress, ensuring the following elements are replicated accurately:
* **Header:** Include company logo and navigation menu matching the original layout and design.
* **Hero Banner/Slider:** Create a full\-width hero section with a background image/video, overlay text, and buttons, mirroring the original page.
* **Featured Services/Content:** Design sections showcasing key services or projects, with appropriate styling, icons, or images.
* **Portfolio/Video Section:** Implement a section displaying projects or videos, with text descriptions and links to more information.
* **Footer:** Recreate the footer with contact details, social media links, and legal/privacy links.
* Ensure the website is:
* Fully responsive across all devices (desktop, tablet, and mobile).
* Optimized for speed using basic WordPress optimization techniques (e.g., image compression, caching).
* Includes custom CSS/JavaScript where necessary for design effects (e.g., hover states, animations, transitions).
* Built using clean and modular code for easy future maintenance.
* Adheres to basic SEO best practices (proper heading structure, image alt attributes, etc.).
* **Submission:**

**How to Apply:**  
Please send your assignment, resume, portfolio, and a brief description of your most challenging WordPress project to **talent@viacomindia.com**.

We look forward to seeing your work!

 **Organizational Context**
Key Aspects:* **Part of the Aditya Birla Capital Limited, Aditya Birla Housing Finance Limited (ABHFL) is registered with the National Housing Bank as a housing finance company under the National Housing Bank Act, 1987\. The company offers a complete range of housing finance solutions such as home loans, home improvement and home construction loans, balance transfer and top\-up loans, loans against property and construction finance. The company acquired its license on 9****th** **July 2014 and has aggressive growth plans.**
* ABHFL has grown at a steady rate while reporting good asset quality despite challenges in the operating environment. While the industry is dominated by five large groups, there has been an emergence of segments like Affordable and self\-employed borrowers, given the high potential in these segments. Despite increased focus by banks, HFCs have been able to maintain their share in the mortgage market. and is poised for rapid growth and plans to grow 5X (40,000 Cr) in the next 5 years. This shall take ABHFL within the top 5 percentile of HFCs in the country.
* **The ABHFL Sales organization works broadly with 3 customer segments – retail (individual) customers, institutional customers (for retail and institutional loan consumers) and builders (for both retail tie\-ups and construction finance), with a major share of the business coming from retail customers. Client segments can also be divided into Salaried and Self\-employed, with both of these having very different preferences and needs.**

**Job Context**
Key Aspects:* **Providing housing finance (to buyers), Loan against Property, Commercial Property Purchase, Lease Rental Discounting and Construction Finance (to builders) solutions, ABHFL caters to a diverse range of customer segments through its various service offerings. Additionally, being predominantly retail driven, the business is characterized by high volume of loan transactions and customer relationships. As a result, ABHFL business performance is strongly impacted by people, process and organizational efficiencies, alongside core business drivers such as product/ solution quality, channel and customer relationship management and risk management.**
* **While unit of sizing up the business is its loan book size, profitability and minimized delinquency are also key business objectives.**
* **Higher cost of funding impacts profitability as well as competitiveness of loan rates that can be offered to clients**
* **For retail customers, identifying and acting on relevant needs for target demographics/ customer segments/ etc., in an efficient manner ensuring process, statutory and regulatory compliance at all times, are key for building business performance and sustainability.**
* **For institutional/ builder customers, understanding and addressing complex business requirements via proactive relationship management and customized solution fitment, while ensuring compliance at all times, are important to gain competitive advantage in this segment.**
* **The Sales Manager (Direct) – ABHFL is responsible for achieving sales targets through direct channels, as agreed with the ASM\-ABHFL, in terms of targeted book size, growth \& customer service objectives.**

**Key Challenges*** To assign sales targets to team members considering local factors impacting business, such as competitor presence, existing relationships, new prospect opportunities, etc., and ensure achievement of set targets
* To upgrade financial \& operational know how of self and team members on industry dynamics, effective negotiation and relationship building, and efficient loan processing for maintaining lasting relationships with customers while ensuring portfolio health and profitability
* To drive loan conversion/ sanction/ utilization rates and ensure an appropriate sourcing funnel to meet targets
* To ensure credit quality, effective portfolio selection/ pre\-screening, and work closely with Risk team members to minimize potential NPAs while driving sales
* To ensure compliant sales operations at all times, despite sales pressures and market cycles

 **Enabling Skill Sets \& Qualifications*** Critical skill sets required to meet these challenges include commercial acumen, team management and communication, product\-market awareness, and execution skills.
* **Education \& experience required to fulfil this profile are a graduate with minimum 5 \- 7 yrs of total sales experience in the Banking/ NBFC space, of which at least recent 2 \- 3 yrs experience should be in HFC sales.**

title: Human Resource People Partner
description:
What You'll Do:

You will facilitate core People Partner processes across Avalara's India operations. You will provide proactive, high\-judgment support to People Partners and first\-line managers, including employee lifecycle changes, policy application, data quality and reporting, and termination and offboarding processes.


As an HR People Partner career\-level individual contributor, you are a HR professional with a full understanding of your area of specialization. You can resolve issues in creative, practical ways. Avalara expects you to model its P\&C expectations, Avalara's culture embodies you, and you raise the bar for quality, judgment, and execution in every interaction.


What Your Responsibilities Will Be:
**Business partnering**

* Take lead and direction from the Senior People Partner to implement the people strategy for the business, translating high\-level direction into clear plans and actions for your scope.
* Provide daily guidance to first\-line managers on people topics. These topics include department changes, employee relations, performance management, talent reviews, change programs, and more. Ensure that all actions conform to regulatory and legislative requirements.
* Challenge constructively and directly. Be respectful, fact\-based, and willing to question the status quo. This approach roots itself in ownership and a genuine commitment to raising performance.
* Partner with Centers of Excellence, such as Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, TM/LD, HR Services, and Legal, to resolve issues end\-to\-end.
* Be a primary contact for people\-related queries within your client groups, evaluation, resolving, or routing to People Partners.

**HR proficiency and operational excellence**

* Lead and contribute to projects that promote People Partner goals and programs in India (e.g., performance management, position eliminations execution support, policy changes, or programs driven through ServiceNow ticketing and Workday).
* Support implementation of people programs and policies through communications planning, project management, partner education, and high\-quality documentation.
* Maintain knowledge of India employment law and compliance requirements and apply them pragmatically in partnership with People Partners and Employee Relations.
* Be an primary liaison with business/departments on ER matters (performance issues, accommodations, policy violations, job eliminations), escalating to Senior or Global People Partners and Legal.
* Provide accurate and well\-documented administrative and tactical support to People Partners (e.g., Workday changes, documentation, letters, audits, and employee records).

**AI\-first mindset and data**

* Connect structure, capability, performance, reward, and culture to design **simple, scalable, AI\-enabled solutions** that improve outcomes at enterprise level
* Use data (workforce, ticketing, ER trends, performance outcomes) to define problems, measure progress, and recommend trade\-offs; treat anecdotes as context, not direction.
* Use AI tools, such as Avi, Co\-pilot, and ChatGPT, to automate repeatable work. Additionally, use HR systems like Workday, ServiceNow, and HRIS/ATS to enhance employee experience.

**Storytelling, communication, and culture**

* Explain the **“why”**, trade\-offs, and expected outcomes of people decisions, linking them to our goals and employee experience


You will report to Director, People Partner


What You'll Need to be Successful:
* **Experience:**
	+ Minimum 4\+ years of HR experience in a global organization
	+ Master's degree in Human Resources
	+ Experience supporting India\-based employee populations and partnering with global stakeholders strongly preferred.
* **Technical skills:**
	+ Experience with HR systems (e.g., Workday, HRIS, ATS) and collaboration tools (Microsoft Office, Zoom, Slack).
	+ Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT, Avi) to drive efficiency, insight, and better employee/manager experiences.
* **Professional skills and traits:**
	+ Demonstrated urgency, ownership, curiosity, humility, and passion for building a high\-performance, fair, and fun culture.
	+ Ability to manage confidential information with discretion and maintain strong documentation and audit\-ready records.


\#LI\-Onsite


Avalara is an AI\-first Company:

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


How We'll Take Care of You:

Total Rewards


In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

  

Health \& Wellness  

Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.  

Inclusive culture and diversity  

Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.  


What You Need To Know About Avalara:

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.  

We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world.  

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too. **We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Ocean Freight Rate Card Maintenance Team Lead
description:
DHL Global Forwarding (DGF) is the world leader in air freight services and one of the leading providers of ocean freight services. Around 30,000 employees work to ensure we transport our customers of shipments by air or sea. DGF's logistics solutions span the entire supply chain, from the factory to the shop floor. This also includes special transport\-related services.
As the experts in freight forwarding, we deliver 100% assurance to our customers via a mindset that’s always looking ahead to the next commercial opportunity, predicting the next potential issue, anticipating the next global trend.


Because at DHL Global Forwarding, Freight, we’re not simply about freight forwarding. We’re about forward\-thinking ways to connect people – and improve their lives.

**Job purpose**


The Ocean Freight Rate Card Maintenance Team Lead is responsible for managing a team of rate card maintenance specialists that owns and maintains post‑award customer rate cards end‑to‑end. The role enables and develops the team members to work independently and confidently, make informed decisions without constant escalation, and deliver competitive quotations for additional lanes as well as timely updates to surcharges, transit times, extensions, and refreshes. In addition, the role acts as their first point of contact to resolve doubts and will be the interface to the Growth team in case alignment with Tender Managers or Pricing Specialists is required. By establishing clear SOPs and training, and by defining guidelines and quality checks, the Team Lead ensures accurate rate card maintenance, mapping and bundling charges in line with customer requirements, and handover of rate cards to upload in RMS/CW1 by the Rate Card Loading team to enable auto‑rating and billing accuracy.

  

**Principal accountabilities**

**Team Leadership and Management**

* Operates with minimal supervision, sets priorities and SLAs.
* Conducts 4‑eyes reviews
* Builds team autonomy through training, coaching, and knowledge assets so the reporting team can own their topics and make informed decisions without constant escalation.

**Rate Card Maintenance**

* Handles complex, ambiguous, and multi‑party issues (e.g., conflicting instructions, data gaps across IPT/CPT, cross‑system issues).
* Challenges pricing assumptions and optimizes mapping/bundling per customer (in partnership with Tender Managers/Product) to improve quote hit ratio, protect margin, and grow the business via proactive additional lanes with competitive rates.
* Ensures latest rate card and respective updates are available and Rate Card Loading tickets are raised timely (initial/partial loading, rate extension/refresh, additional lanes, surcharges updates).
* Take control of the surcharge’s expiry.
* Full alignment with Regional and Country Growth/OCC.

**Process Documentation and Improvement**


* Applies deep functional and cross‑functional expertise (pricing, product, billing, systems) and translates it into SOPs and process governance (definition and maintenance of the process)
* Identifies and applies improvements needed, data standards, checklists, version control, and approval workflows
* Ensures audit readiness, and data integrity across the post‑award rate card lifecycle
* Coaches the team to internalize and apply the process consistently, enabling the team to work independently.

**Stakeholder Engagement and Collaboration**


* Acts as the escalation point for Tender Managers, Product/Pricing, Finance/Billing, and Operations.
* Translates commercial intent into clear data rules and timelines, manage refresh calendars
* Communicates decisions and impacts.

**Own KPIs**


* Set targets and run disciplined reviews across TAT, First‑Time‑Right, SLA adherence, Surcharges Expiry, rate accuracy with no incidents
* Drive corrective/preventive actions.

**Quality, Risk \& Continuous Improvement**


* Leads root cause analysis on pricing‑data issues impacting rating/billing
* Implements validation rules
* Raises automation needs to reduce cycle time, rework and minimize risk.

**Skills**


* Proficiency in Excel and database tools/systems
* Pricing and rate process expertise
* Deep understanding of freight forwarding and supply chain logistics
* Extensive knowledge of forwarding, ocean carriers, and transport providers
* Strong ownership, data‑driven decision‑making and accountability
* Structured and detail oriented
* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to perform effectively in dynamic, fast\-paced environment with high\-pressure situations
* Stakeholder leadership \& escalation management

**Qualifications \& Key Requirements**


* More than 4 years in freight forwarding, logistics, or shipping industry with at least 2 years in a pricing leadership role.
* Experience with business intelligence tools and platforms.
* Experience applying Project Management skills and principles including scheduling, resource allocation, task dependencies and coordination.
* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Logistics, Business or Information Systems would be considered benefitial.
* Professional proficiency in business English, both spoken and written.

**Location**


Mumbai, India

**RCS Grade**


I

**Your benefits**


We offer excellent employee benefits, a competitive salary package and great development opportunities.


* Positive work environment: Our TOP EMPLOYER prestigious certification attests to our best\-in\-class efforts to attract and retain talent by fostering a positive work environment and encouraging personal and professional development among employees
* Comprehensive Benefits Package: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes health insurance, retirement plans, social counseling, generous corporate discount programs and other employee wellbeing programs.
* Global Exposure: Joining DHL Global Forwarding means being part of a truly global organization, providing you with the opportunity to work with diverse teams and gain exposure to international markets and practices.
* Work\-Life Balance: We understand the importance of maintaining a healthy work\-life balance, and we strive to provide a flexible work environment.
* Continuous Learning and Development: We invest in our employees' growth by offering training programs, coaching, workshops, and resources to enhance your skills and knowledge.
* Onboarding: Individual onboarding, training on the job, networking, a dedicated certified program.

  

Interested in this position? Just click on “Apply”!

  

Are you curious to learn more about us?


Our official website: DHL Global Forwarding


Check out our business updates and culture: LinkedIn/ Instagram / Facebook \& X

  

We are looking forward to your application.


DGF HR Team

description:
### **About Us**

**Join our World of Talent.**



Global, culturally diverse, inclusive, and innovative \- welcome to AMS, where talent is our world. Over the last two decades, AMS has redefined the landscape of talent outsourcing and consulting. From pioneering the concept of RPO to continually revolutionizing how organizations approach talent acquisition, AMS stands as a world leader in the industry.



Committed, engaged, and inspired, we feel a real sense of belonging, and all have one thing in common: a real passion for talent. Become part of this world and make a difference with us.

### **The Role**


At AMS, **talent is our world**—and now, we're expanding that world with a fresh perspective.



Talent Sourcers play a critical role by partnering with Hiring Managers and Recruiters to build strong, consultative relationships and deeply understand each hiring need. Using data, market insights, and tailored sourcing strategies, they identify and engage the best talent in the market. As brand ambassadors, they present opportunities authentically, ensuring candidates are well‑qualified and genuinely interested before reaching the Hiring Manager.



A Principal Talent Sourcer is a true subject matter expert—confidently partnering with senior stakeholders, navigating complex hiring requirements, and designing strategies to engage passive, high‑calibre talent across specialized disciplines.

### **Key Accountabilities**

* Source and deliver high‑quality candidates across Technology, HR, and Finance functions — including roles such as Software Engineering, Information Security, BI/Analytics, HRBPs, Talent Management, Compensation \& Benefits, Payroll, FP\&A, AR/AP, Audit, and other specialist positions.
* Develop and execute bespoke sourcing strategies using talent intelligence, market insights, and historical hiring trends to attract niche and passive talent across multiple domains.
* Partner closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to understand complex hiring needs, define ideal talent profiles, and influence hiring decisions with data‑backed recommendations.
* Leverage advanced sourcing techniques (Boolean, X‑Ray, GitHub/Tech platforms, HR communities, Finance networks, market mapping) to build strong pipelines of multi‑discipline talent.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders by presenting curated shortlists, competitor intelligence, and proactive insights on talent availability across Tech, HR, and Finance markets.
* Drive candidate engagement by articulating compelling role narratives and ensuring strong qualification, interest, and alignment prior to Hiring Manager submission.
* Lead talent intelligence initiatives including talent pool creation, diversity mapping, and benchmarking across functional domains.
* Mentor and guide junior sourcers, lead problem‑solving sessions, and champion best practices within the sourcing community.
* Partner across business units to anticipate future skill needs and build long‑term talent pipelines for critical and hard‑to‑fill Tech, HR, and Finance roles.
* Maintain high data accuracy across ATS/CRM systems and provide insights for reporting, dashboards, and hiring analytics.

### **Skills \& Requirements**

* 7\+ years of experience in similar domain setup.
* Strong stakeholder management skills.
* Highly proficient in maintaining and tracking large volumes of data.
* Open to work in a Hybrid setup (preferably Pune, Delhi, or Hyderabad).
* Energetic, proactive, and demonstrates task ownership with strong relationship\-building skills for long\-term success.

title: PR Executive/ Manager- PR Agency- Mumbai/ Ahmedabad/ Pune/ Delhi
description:
WFO\- 5 days

Location: Mumbai/ Pune/ Ahmedabad/ Bangalore

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a passionate and trend\-savvy **PR Executive** to join our beauty and fashion PR team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for creating and implementing PR strategies that enhance brand visibility, engage with influencers, and drive media coverage. This role requires a strong understanding of the beauty and fashion industry, excellent communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Media Relations**: Cultivate and maintain relationships with beauty and fashion editors, journalists, and influencers to secure media placements and endorsements.
* **Press Materials**: Write, edit, and distribute press releases, media kits, product sheets, and other PR materials that highlight new product launches, brand milestones, and events.
* **Influencer Engagement**: Identify, build, and manage relationships with beauty and fashion influencers and brand ambassadors to amplify campaigns and promote products.
* **Event Coordination**: Plan and execute brand events, such as product launches, fashion shows, and influencer meet\-and\-greets, ensuring they align with brand objectives and create media buzz.
* **Trend Monitoring**: Stay up\-to\-date with beauty and fashion trends, competitor activities, and consumer insights, incorporating these into PR strategies.
* **Digital PR**: Work with the social media team to develop online campaigns that support PR objectives, engage audiences, and monitor brand mentions.
* **Product Placements**: Strategize product placements in media outlets, influencer content, and editorial pieces to drive brand awareness.
* **Brand Storytelling**: Create and pitch compelling stories that resonate with audiences and reinforce brand values in beauty and fashion.
* **Reporting and Analytics**: Track, analyze, and report on media coverage, campaign performance, and engagement to assess the impact of PR initiatives.

**Key Qualifications:**

* **Experience**: 2\+ years of PR experience, preferably in beauty, fashion, lifestyle, or a related field.
* **Education**: Bachelor’s degree in Public Relations, Communications, Fashion Marketing, or a related field.
* **Communication Skills**: Strong written and verbal communication skills with a flair for storytelling and brand voice.
* **Industry Knowledge**: Deep understanding of beauty and fashion trends, consumer preferences, and media landscape.
* **Influencer Relations**: Experience working with beauty and fashion influencers, with a network of industry contacts being a plus.
* **Organizational Skills**: Strong project management skills, attention to detail, and ability to juggle multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

title: Global MD Executive Talent Senior Manager
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


To be the best partner for driving lasting change with our clients, BCG invests in, develops, and partners with specialty businesses to deepen our expertise, broaden our capabilities, and support our clients with what they need to win. The most senior leaders in these businesses are Managing Directors (MDs), and we are looking for a talented HR professional to drive the MD Executive Talent function in Asia Pacific.

  

In this role, you will contribute to the best\-in\-class Executive Talent services provided to our specialty Managing Directors across AP. You will be partnering with a variety of senior leaders across BCG and Specialty businesses in driving an enhanced value proposition for our MDs. It also requires to design and drive processes and services that contribute to the development of their careers and learning, as well as deliver first class hiring, contracting and compensation services that meet HR Executive Talent standards. Both the rigorous management of the related information (including the most sensitive) and of very diverse stakeholders are key success factors in this role.

  

As an HR BP, you will be responsible, including but not limited to:

* Be a trusted and credible partner representing the MD model. Own, facilitate, and provide senior level support for the career development and performance processes for our Managing Directors, and ensure that our MD Career Development Committees (MDDCs) run smoothly and deliver robust career development, rewards, and recognition for our executives
* Lead and play key decision support role in MD life cycle events (lateral hires, onboarding, promotions, transfers, departures, and terminations), driving consistency with global norms. Ensure timely and comprehensive expert involvement and alignment with local and regional HR and Legal teams, global Centers of Excellence, and specialty business leadership
* Working closely with Global Compensation and Finance teams. Play a key role in the annual planning cycle, including MD target setting, tracking, analysis and measurement
* Contribute to the evolution of MD career framework and learning \& development offerings. Partner with senior leaders on promotion decisions, talent pipeline, and tailored solutions for executive development needs
* Proactively suggest, and autonomously implement ongoing improvements to experience, quality, and level of support delivered through our processes, as well as information and knowledge management
* Act as point of contact for all MD queries related to employee relations, career development, compensation and change programs
* Support relevant change initiatives to enhance our MD value proposition

  

Additionally, you will support the evolution of our processes, policies and tools, for example:

* processes and practices for onboarding new MDs, training Career Advisors, MD L\&D curriculum

  

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in business, Human Resources or related field
* 10\+ years of experience in Human Resources with strong expertise in career development processes or experience in senior talent career development, and/or BCG consulting experience at Consultant /Project Leader level, ideally with people, talent, and organization experience
* Experience in managing complex stakeholder group and a strong track\-record of building deep\-lasting relationships with key stakeholders
* Experience in consulting strongly desirable
* Proficiency in managing large sets of confidential information and basic analytics
* Strong skills in Windows Office (in particular, PowerPoint and Excel) and new digital information sharing and management tools (Egnyte, Slack, etc.)

  

Who You'll Work With


As a member of our Global HR team, the MD HR Executive Talent Senior Manager will liaise effectively with the senior leaders of our Specialty Businesses, BCG Centers of Expertise, regional and local HR Ops and Finance counterparts as well as internal lawyers.

  

This will involve working remotely with team members, stakeholders and counterparts, located in various geographies.

  

Additional info


We are looking for someone who:

* Thrives in a fast\-paced, global, intellectually intense, and service\-oriented environment
* Is an active team player with excellent interpersonal skills, tact, a positive attitude and an ability to generate trust, influence, and build relationships with senior stakeholders
* Possesses strong organizational, operational, analytical and conceptual skills to successfully manage processes in a complex, matrixed organization
* Is a creative solution seeker and problem solver who proactively seeks to improve the experience and quality of support delivered to our stakeholders
* Has strong oral and written communication skills and the ability to adapt to various audiences and communicate effectively
* Is a self\-starter with the ability to work independently with limited supervision
* Demonstrates high integrity, ethics and respect for confidentiality and sensitivity of personal information

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

description:
